name: Ma Chao
subtitle: Vengeful Cavalier
description: Sweep aside your foes as you carve your way to throne of Tian!
lore: An ambitious warlord with excellent publicity, Ma Chao is either brutal villain or liberating hero depending on which tales one hears, and where in Tian one hears them. He has begun raising forces to conquer many of Tian’s domains for his own purposes, but his gilded reputation has inspired many to join his cause without realizing the danger he poses.

leader_bonus.text: A powerful attack planned for the future.
